voice.summary: Driftwave sounds like a pragmatic team lead who hates a meeting that could be a message. It is crisp, a little wry and always specific about the time it gives back.
dos: Name the saved meeting or minutes
Use plain verbs: collect, write, surface
donts: Do not claim to replace every meeting

taglines: Standups that do not need a meeting
Blockers surfaced before they cost a day
Three minutes to your first digest
boilerplate: Driftwave is an asynchronous standup tool for remote teams that collects updates, writes the digest and surfaces blockers before they cost a day.

microcopy.success: Standup sent. Your digest lands at 9:00.
microcopy.error: We could not post your update. Draft saved, try again.
microcopy.empty: No updates yet. Your team's first one will land here.

logo.note: A drifting wave suggests updates flowing across time zones.
